gamerule.propwash.foreign_ghosts.descrip: Who may watch the replay of another pilot's leaderboard time and fly against their ghost. All (default): every player. Admins: only operators. Off: nobody may fly against other pilots' ghosts; operators can still open every replay, for example to check times at an event. Your own times are always available.
propwash.race.config.ghost_mode.tooltip: Exactly one ghost flies along in races, and splits show the gap to it. Own: your personal best lap with your drone class (in laps with flight assist your assisted ghost). From leaderboard: the course record of your class, or the time you picked in the leaderboard with “Fly against”. Off: no ghost. A choice made in the leaderboard is remembered per course.
propwash.race.ghosts.hint: Click a time for the drone's share code, the replay and its ghost
propwash.race.ghosts.hint_empty: Times show up here once laps are flown
propwash.race.ghosts.no_code: No share code stored for this time
propwash.race.ghosts.copy.tooltip: Copies the share code of the drone that flew this time
propwash.race.ghosts.import.tooltip: Opens the share code in the import tab, where you can build the drone
propwash.race.ghosts.replay.tooltip: Watch this time from the FPV view of the drone. The replay only shows the flight path the server recorded itself.
propwash.race.ghosts.replay.flying: Not available while you fly or use the free camera
propwash.race.ghosts.replay.offline: This server does not provide replays
propwash.race.ghosts.no_ghost: The server has no recording for this time (flown before replays existed, or the recording was too long)
propwash.race.ghosts.denied_replay: The world rule “Others' ghosts and replays” does not allow you to watch this replay
propwash.race.ghosts.denied_opponent: The world rule “Others' ghosts and replays” does not allow you to fly against this ghost
propwash.race.ghosts.opponent.tooltip: Fly against this ghost: in your next laps on this course, it is the only ghost flying along and your splits are measured against it
propwash.race.ghosts.own.tooltip: This ghost is your opponent. Click to fly against your own best lap again.
propwash.race.ghosts.own.chosen: Your own ghost flies along on %s again
propwash.race.ghosts.remove.tooltip: Admins only: deletes the times of %s in this class from the leaderboard together with the recording. The list moves up, a record passes to the next best time. Click twice to confirm.
propwash.race.ghosts.remove.denied: Only operators may delete times from the leaderboard.
propwash.race.ghosts.remove.none: No matching time found – the leaderboard has changed in the meantime.
propwash.race.ghosts.command.unknown_pil: No pilot named %s on the leaderboard of course %s.
propwash.race.replay.title: Replay
propwash.race.replay.head: Replay · %s · %s · %s
propwash.race.replay.failed.missing: The recording of this time is no longer available (time deleted or course changed).
propwash.race.replay.failed.denied: The world rule “Others' ghosts and replays” does not allow you to watch this replay.
propwash.race.replay.failed.busy: The server is busy – please try again in a moment.
propwash.race.replay.failed.broken: The recording could not be read.
propwash.race.replay.failed.offline: This server does not provide replays.
propwash.race.replay.view.tooltip: FPV: the image of the drone's camera with its camera angle, as in the goggles. Behind the drone: the camera follows the drone from behind, useful to judge shortcuts (V key).
propwash.race.replay.video.tooltip: Plays this time once from the start at 1× in the chosen view (FPV or behind the drone) and records it with the Action Cam's resolution and quality. The video goes to the Action Cam folder, without sound. Esc cancels.
propwash.race.replay.video.loading: Available once the replay has loaded
propwash.race.replay.video.busy: The Action Cam is recording right now
propwash.race.replay.video.saving_blocke: Available once the last video has been saved
propwash.race.replay.video.no_ffmpeg: Needs ffmpeg, which was not found. Install it and press Test in the Action Cam tab, section “Faster recording with ffmpeg”; the guide button there explains how.
propwash.race.replay.video.ffmpeg_broken: ffmpeg was found but does not start. The Action Cam tab, section “Faster recording with ffmpeg”, shows why.
propwash.race.replay.video.failed: The video could not be recorded: %s
